name: pre-read-never-read-session-with-other-bytes-is-denied-again
description: #514, the control: a deny that the next Read does not clear. B pre-reads CLAUDE.md first, seeding v1 with B's hash. A, which never read the file, offers other bytes and is denied with the out-of-band text (fixture 10). That deny arms nothing, since A has no stale copy to recover, so A's second read of the same bytes is denied with the same text.

hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecisionReason: Stale read denied: CLAUDE.md on disk does not match v1, the last version committed through the coordinator, and no session committed the change, so it was made outside the coordinator. Do not restore or overwrite CLAUDE.md: the change may be your user's work. Tell your user that CLAUDE.md changed outside the coordinator; the read stays denied until the change is committed through the coordinator. This denial is structural (v0.2 strict mode); retrying the same operation will produce the same denial.
